act_title: The Representation of the People Act, 1951
title: Fixing time for poll
text:
56. Fixing time for poll.—The [Election Commission] shall fix the hours during which the poll will be

taken; and the hours so fixed shall be published in such manner as may be prescribed:

Provided that the total period allotted on any one day for polling at an election in [a Parliamentary or

Assembly constituency] shall not be less than eight hours.
